certifications.heading: Certification cards
certifications.levelMapping: Other agencies: CMAS 1★, RAID Open Water 20 and BSAC Ocean Diver → Open Water; CMAS 2★, RAID Advanced 35 and BSAC Sports Diver → Advanced Open Water; CMAS 3★ and BSAC Dive Leader → Divemaster.
certifications.levelMappingCaution: CMAS stars are instructor grades too, so read the card rather than the words on it. GUE does not fit this ladder — record the diver's entry-level card from another agency as well.
certifications.empty: No level cards yet — add their first card above so it can make them trip-ready.

card.refresherDueVerify: Refresher due — verify current status with the agency
card.tapToFlipText: Tap the card to flip and view {target}
card.flipAriaLabel: Digital certification card for {level}. Press to flip.

page.title: Divers
page.noticeDuplicate: A diver with that email is already in this shop.
page.noticeDeleted: Diver removed. Their bookings, cards, and sizes stay on file.
page.noticeRestoreRefused: Couldn't restore that diver — an active diver now uses their email. Change that email, then try again.
page.noticeErased: Personal data erased. The signed release, the trips, and the payments stay on file with the diver's details gone — this cannot be undone.
page.noticeErasedProcessorOwed: Personal data erased here, but something at Stripe isn't finished. Open Reports to see what's left and clear it — until then this diver isn't fully erased.
page.noticeNotAuthorized: Removing or restoring a diver is limited to owners and managers.
page.noticeInvalid: Check the diver's name, email, and phone number.
page.addDiverBody: A name is enough to start. Cards, waivers, and bookings hang off this record.

list.removedNote: These divers are off every list and out of trip prep. Restore one to bring them back.
list.searchHintText: Search by name, email, or phone.
list.tryDifferentSearch: Try a different search or view, or add a new diver above.
list.addOneHere: Add one here or accept a booking to create their person record.
list.emptyImportBody: Coming from a spreadsheet or another system? Bring the whole roster over in one go.

header.diveInsuranceDescription: DAN or any other dive-accident cover the diver carries.

bookActivity.heading: Book an activity
bookActivity.noOpenActivities: No open activities are available right now.
bookActivity.noEmailNote: No email on file — hand this diver their waiver link in person, or add an address to their record.

payments.heading: Payments
payments.noPaymentsYet: No payments yet — they'll appear here once this diver books a trip or you raise an order.
payments.demoRefundHint: Demo orders aren't backed by a live Stripe invoice, so refunds are disabled here.
payments.showOlderPayments: {count, plural, one {Show # older payment} other {Show # older payments}}

remove.heading: Remove from active divers
remove.description: Bookings, cards, and sizes stay on file, and you can undo this.
remove.addAgainNote: You can add them again later as a new active record.

removed.heading: This diver is off your active lists
removed.body: Out of the roster, booking pickers, manifests, and trip prep. Their records stay on file.
removed.restoreRestricted: Only owners and managers can restore a diver.

erase.heading: Erase personal data
erase.description: Destroys this diver's details for good. Not the same as removing them.
erase.destroyedNote: Destroyed: their name, email, phone, date of birth, emergency contact, insurance, card numbers and card photos, medical answers, rental sizes, notes about them, review comments, and any photos they shared.
erase.keptNote: Kept: that they signed your release, which version they signed, and when — plus the trips they were on and what was paid, with their name gone from all of it. Your signed releases stay verifiable.
erase.noUndoNote: There is no undo, and no way to get any of it back. Removing them first is the reversible option.

rentalFit.heading: Rental fit
rentalFit.description: What the trip prep list is built from — never a reservation, and never a substitute for a dock-side fit check.
rentalFit.changeRestricted: Changing what this diver asked for is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters. If a size isn't available, flag them for hands-on fitting below.
rentalFit.cantFillHeading: Can't fill one of these sizes?
rentalFit.flaggedBody: They still count on the prep list, but without a size — the crew fits them from what's aboard.
rentalFit.cantFillBody: Their count stays on the packing list but the size comes off, so nobody lays out a size the shop is short of.
rentalFit.fitResolved: Fit resolved — pack their sizes again
rentalFit.clearingRestricted: Clearing this is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters — they confirm the diver can be packed to their stated sizes again.

history.heading: Shop history
history.importedVisitsText: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} came across from your previous system. Those lines are booking records, not dive records — they say what was booked and what your old software called it.
history.noTripsYet: Nothing here yet — past trips and imported visits show up here.
history.showOlderEntries: {count, plural, one {Show # older entry} other {Show # older entries}}

specialty.heading: Specialty cards
specialty.description: A verified Nitrox card is required before an EANx fill.
specialty.emptyState: No specialty or nitrox cards yet — add one above when they earn it.
specialty.confirmDisclosure: I've seen this diver's card, or checked the number with the issuing agency. Confirming clears {what}.
specialty.whatSpecialtyDive: the {specialty} specialty dive this card allows
specialty.whatNitroxFill: the Nitrox fill this card allows

stats.fitNeedsStaffFit: Flagged for hands-on fitting at check-in
stats.unpaidBookings: {count, plural, one {# booking still owes money} other {# bookings still owe money}}
stats.waiverSignsOnce: Signed once, good for the whole shop

notices.captured: Card captured as pending. Look the number up with the agency, then mark it certified before it can make this diver ready.
notices.verified: Card marked certified. It now counts toward readiness.
notices.cardDeleted: Card removed. It no longer counts toward readiness; its history is kept for records.
notices.cardRestored: Card restored. It counts toward readiness again.
notices.cardRestoreConflict: Couldn't restore that card — another card now uses its number. Re-add it if you still need it.
notices.fitFlagged: Flagged for hands-on fitting. The prep list will show this diver needs staff sizing at check-in.
notices.fitCleared: Fit flag cleared — this diver packs from their stated sizes again.
notices.duplicate: Another diver already uses that email in this shop.
notices.refunded: Payment refunded — the trip now shows as unpaid for this diver.
notices.booked: Activity booked. Review it below, then create and send the invoice.
notices.bookedWaiverUndelivered: Activity booked — but their waiver wasn’t emailed. Open the trip’s guest list to send it or share the link.
notices.tripFull: That activity just filled up. Choose another.
notices.alreadyBooked: This diver is already booked on that activity.
notices.courseUnstaffed: Assign an instructor before booking this course.
notices.coursePrerequisite: Mark the required certification as certified before booking this course.
notices.courseRatioFull: This session is at its instructor-to-student ratio limit. Assign another instructor, or choose another activity.
notices.courseMinAge: This diver is under that course's minimum age on the day it runs, going by the date of birth on file. Correct the date of birth if it's wrong.
notices.tripPrerequisite: This diver's cards on file don't reach what that trip and its dive sites require. Open the trip to see what it asks for.
notices.tripUnavailable: Add an email and choose an available activity.
notices.bookingInvalid: Add an email and choose an available activity.
notices.refundFailed: That payment could not be refunded. It may not be paid, or Stripe may need attention.
notices.refundInProgress: A refund for this order is already going through. Give it a moment, then refresh — don't send it again.
notices.demoDisabled: This is a demo order — it isn't backed by a live Stripe invoice, so it can't be refunded.
notices.deleted: Diver removed. Their bookings, cards, and sizes stay on file.
notices.restored: Diver restored. They're back on your active lists.
notices.restoreRefused: Couldn't restore this diver — an active diver now uses their email. Change that email, then try again.
notices.removedReadOnly: Restore this diver before changing their details — they're off your active lists right now.
notices.paymentNotConnected: Payments aren't connected yet, so there's no account to invoice from — connect one to charge this diver.
notices.notAuthorizedRefund: Refunds are limited to owners and managers — ask one of them to issue this refund.
notices.notAuthorizedDelete: Removing a diver is limited to owners and managers — ask one of them to do it.
notices.notAuthorizedErase: Erasing a diver's personal data is limited to the shop owner — ask them to do it.
notices.eraseNameMismatch: The name you typed doesn't match this diver's, so nothing was erased. Type it exactly as it appears above.
notices.eraseRefused: This record can't be erased. Staff records keep the shop's own accountability trail, and you can't erase your own.
notices.notAuthorizedFit: Changing a diver's stated rental fit is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters. You can still flag them for hands-on fitting at check-in.
notices.cardSightingRequired: Confirming an imported card needs the checkbox: it opens the dive or the fill that card allows, so a staffer has to say they've actually seen it or checked the number with the agency.
notices.invalid: Check the details and try again.
notices.waiverPaperRecorded: Paper waiver recorded — signed and on file.
notices.waiverMedicalAttestation: Confirm you reviewed the medical questionnaire before recording a paper waiver — or send the digital link so the diver answers it.
notices.waiverError: That paper waiver couldn’t be recorded. Open the diver’s next departure to see why.
